description: This file contains the transformProps function for a Treemap chart in Apache Superset, including helper functions for formatting labels and tooltips, and constructs the ECharts options object based on chart data and configuration.

methods.name: formatLabel
methods.description: Formats the label for a treemap node based on label type and number formatter.

methods.name: formatTooltip
methods.description: Generates the tooltip HTML for a treemap node, including metric value and percentage relative to parent.

methods.name: transformProps
methods.description: Main function that transforms chart properties into ECharts options for a Treemap chart, including data processing, styling, and configuration.
